Stream Orchestrator.description: Accountable for the Stream delivering its outcomes, defining the domain, and setting targets.

questions.prompt: What is the formal name of this Atomic Stream?
questions.help_text: Example: Checkout Flow Stream or Core Infrastructure Stream.

questions.prompt: Define the bounded product domain this Stream owns. What is in scope, and what is explicitly out of scope?
questions.help_text: Keep this definitive. Example: 'Owns user authentication and profile management. Out of scope: billing and payments.'

questions.prompt: Who are the target user groups for this domain? (Comma separated)
questions.help_text: Example: B2B Admins, Free Tier End-Users.

questions.prompt: What is the current Step 1 Initiative (the measurable outcome target) the Stream is accountable for?
questions.help_text: Example: 'Increase repeat purchase rate by 15% by Q4.'

questions.prompt: What industry does this Stream operate within?
List the URLs of existing wikis, API docs, or precedent records agents must reference.
questions.help_text: Agents will use these to ground their context before making decisions.

questions.prompt: Where are the brand guidelines, UI libraries, and tone-of-voice rules located?
questions.help_text: Required for frontend or copy-generating agents to maintain consistency.

questions.prompt: Describe the personality and tone the agents should use when messaging the team.
questions.help_text: Example: 'Direct, cynical, and highly technical' or 'Enthusiastic and supportive.' Note: This only applies to team chat integrations, not generated code.

System Architect.description: Accountable for system coherence, non-functional requirements, and defining technical boundaries.

questions.prompt: What is the primary tech stack? (Comma separated)
questions.help_text: This determines which baseline security and architecture guardrails are automatically applied. Example: React, Node.js, Postgres.

questions.prompt: Beyond standard best practices, what are the absolute architectural boundaries unique to this company?
questions.help_text: Example: 'Do not invoke any external API without passing through the central gateway layer.'

questions.prompt: Who is the named compliance contact for Tier 3 (irreversible/regulated) release sign-offs?
questions.help_text: This is a framework requirement. Provide the Slack handle, email, or Discord ID.

questions.prompt: Which platform and specific channel should agents use for halt conditions and escalations?

Platform Engineer.description: Accountable for the ground the Streams run on, including routing, access, and pipeline infrastructure.

questions.prompt: What is the base URL of the system of record where Flow Artefacts will be logged?
questions.help_text: Example: https://jira.yourcompany.com or a Linear team URL.

questions.prompt: What is the URL of the product codebase repository this Stream operates on?
questions.help_text: The codebase repo, not this governance repo.

questions.prompt: What is the webhook or endpoint URL where agents must send their output to invoke the Scribe service?
questions.help_text: Example: A catch-all n8n webhook URL that processes and routes Flow Artefacts.

questions.prompt: Which external systems or APIs are agents in this Stream explicitly permitted to reach?
questions.help_text: Example: Stripe API (Read-only), AWS S3, GitHub API.
